limits: Conceptual runtime tokens are not existing production fields
Synthetic event sequences do not run original C# or track routing
No Unity, real UI, storage, AI race, weather or balance acceptance
Atomic wallet writes are injected model fixtures; current PlayerPrefs adapter does not provide that transaction
Design alternatives, driver identity and new save fields remain unapproved
